sections.description:
Implement creative ideas with drawings directly in WordPress!

Impress your website visitors with striking charts, icons and sketches! You create and edit these directly in the backend without having to leave WordPress. This gives your site a unique look.
With neoDraw you can implement your creative ideas quickly and easily!

🏝️ Sandbox for neo Draw

Try neo Draw directly in the browser without having to install it.

→ Start Sandbox

🚀️ Main Features of neo Draw

  • ✅ Unleash your creativity with advanced drawing tools in WordPress 🎉
  • ✅ Create diagrams with shapes, icons and freehand drawings
  • ✅ Unlimited drawings like charts, symbols and other graphics
  • ✅ Paint on existing images or add text overlays
  • ✅ SVG export and import on other sites
  • ✅ Image editing with Apple Pencil to quickly write annotations and create scribble drawings
  • ✅ Convert CSV files into a chart
  • ✅ Interactive image areas through linked overlays
  • ✅ Professional fonts with a large font selection
  • ✅ Export as SVG vector graphic or PNG file
  • ✅ Integration with Bricks, Elementor, Gutenberg, the Classic Editor and the WordPress Media Library
  • ✅ Large catalog of symbols and icons
  • ➡️ Create drawings, diagrams and sketches directly in WordPress.

🎉 Be the king of neoUniverse

Get the ultimate bundle!

  • 🗂️ neoLibrary
    Bring order to your media library and see where your images are used!
  • ✏️ neoRename
    Maximize your image SEO with AI efficiently. Free or with your own API connection.
  • 💬 neoAlt
    Create alt texts and image titles directly in WordPress using AI – includes 300 free image alt text generations every month!
  • 🔄 neoReplace
    Easy replace with drag and drop!
  • 🖇️ neoDuplicate
    Duplicate images for SEO to have page-specific alt texts.
  • 🚀 neoOptimize
    Optimize your image SEO by serving images at the resolution they are displayed in the browser.
  • 🎨 neoDraw
    Bring creative ideas to life with drawings directly in WordPress!
  • 🎬 neoAnimate
    Make an impression with animated path-line effects!
  • 🏃‍♂️ neoMotion
    Impress with fascinating stop-motion animations!
  • ✨ neoPlugins
    All free neoMedia plugins for WordPress.

❤️ Our Drive

Feedback on neo Draw from WP pros that drives us every day:

  • … A very intuitive and powerful drawing tool. The whole design looks very coherent and well thought out.
    Florens Bach ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
  • … The plugin is super fast and perfectly integrated into WordPress. Editing drawings is possible directly in the page builder.
    Jonas Gruber ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
  • … You can easily draw anything: logos, icons, tables, decorations, … Drawing and painting over existing images is also possible.
    Sasha Simonova ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

➔ Read more reviews

🎁 Help us, neo Draw get even better! Your opinion matters. ➔ Send us feedback

🔮 Glimpse into the future

We are currently developing these features:

  • Exclusive pro icon libraries for better design

➔ Request another feature

🔍 Related Plugins

We learned from the best to develop the Whiteboard plugin. If you’re looking for an alternative to neo Draw check out the following plugins:

  • WP Paint – WordPress Image Editor – Features: Image editor, media, media editor, photo, photo editor
  • Painterro – Features: crop, image, paint
  • Sketch Block – Features: block, blocks, drawing, freehand, sketch
  • Interactive Image Map Plugin – Draw Attention – Features: floor plan, hotspot, Image Map, image maps, interactive images
  • Vision – Interactive Image Map with Hotspots Builder – Features: hotspots, infographics

🤝️ Compatibility

The Whiteboard plugin offers maximum compatibility:

  • Tested from WordPress 6.2 and PHP 8.0. Optimized for WP 7.1.
  • Multilingual support for e.g. English, German, …
  • The Whiteboard plugin integrates seamlessly into the WordPress backend and is compatible with WooCommerce.
  • Compatible media file types: SVG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, AVIF, PNG, GIF, TIF, BMP, MP4, MOV, WEBM, AVI, MP3, WAV, PDF, TXT, ZIP, …
  • The Whiteboard plugin is compatible with all major page builders and has been tested with: Bricks, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, …

🛡️ Security & Performance

The Whiteboard plugin keeps your data secure and your website fast:

  • Regular updates for maximum reliability and security
  • Productive testing of new plugin updates by WordPress experts
  • Resource-efficient for a fast WordPress backend
  • SEO optimized for higher search engine rankings
  • Clean uninstallation without leftover database entries
  • German security according to EU standards GDPR and DSGVO

Help and Support

  • WordPress Forum: https://wp.org/support/plugin/neo-draw
  • neo Draw Free support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#free
  • neo Draw Pro support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#pro

Get Pro Features

Find out what the Pro version of neo Draw has to offer to unlock the full potential of your media. ➔ What the Pro version can do

Installation & Activation

Installation via the WordPress Plugin Directory

  • Open the WordPress backend > Plugins > Add New Plugin
  • Search for “neo Draw” and click “Install Now”.
  • After installation click “Activate”.

Installation from neo Draw from the official neoWP website

  • Download the Whiteboard plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Open the WordPress backend > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > Activate the plugin

Manual installation of neo Draw via FTP

  • Download the Whiteboard plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Extract the ZIP file and upload the neo-draw folder via FTP to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  • Go to the WordPress backend > Plugins > In the list click on “neo Draw” and click “Activate”.

After activating the Whiteboard plugin

  • Click in the sidebar of the WordPress backend on “neoWP” to review and adjust the default options.
  • Adjust the “neo Draw” settings to your individual requirements.

Compatibility and Requirements

Minimum system requirements for the Whiteboard plugin

  • WordPress version 6.2 to 7.1
  • PHP version 8.0 or higher
  • MySQL version 8.0 or higher
  • Optimized for servers with Linux operating system (not Windows)
  • Server memory limit: min. 128 MB

Compatible plugins and tools for neo Draw

The plugin neo Draw was tested with: Bricks, Elementor, Divi, Beaver, Oxygen, Breakdance, Gutenberg, WP Fastest Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP-Optimize, Autoptimize, Breeze, Cache Enabler

Legal notice for the Whiteboard plugin

The plugin neo Draw is provided free of charge under the “GPLv2 or later” license and without warranty. Use is at your own risk; liability for damages is excluded. Users outside Germany are responsible for complying with local regulations. This plugin may contact external services for licensing via Freemius (EULA, License Terms, Opt-In Information, Privacy Policy), updates and support. When you submit the feedback feature, the entered text, the optionally shown email address and website domain as well as plugin slug, edition, plugin, WordPress and PHP version, language and browser user agent are transmitted to the neoWP download server. The data are sent by email to the neoWP team and fully stored in a server log protected from public access to understand the feedback and, if necessary, respond. IP address, origin and referrer are not stored in the feedback log or in the feedback email. Email address and domain can be hidden before sending.
Details about data, recipients, storage and third-country transfers can be found in the full privacy policy.
When you open “Browse libraries” in Excalidraw, its browser connects to the external Excalidraw Library service at libraries.excalidraw.com to display public libraries and import selected library items. For technical reasons, the IP address and request data as well as, via URL parameters, the return URL of the WordPress installation, the Excalidraw Library version and a technical import token are transmitted to Excalidraw s.r.o. The Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy of Excalidraw apply.
If you embed external content into Excalidraw or open a drawing with such an embed, the browser loads the content and, if applicable, widget scripts directly from the respective service to display it within the drawing. The embedded URL or content ID and, for technical reasons, in particular IP address, user agent, referrer and any provider cookies are transmitted. Supported services include YouTube (Terms, Privacy), Vimeo (Terms, Privacy), Figma (Terms, Privacy), Excalidraw (Terms, Privacy), GitHub Gists (Terms, Privacy), X/Twitter (Terms, Privacy), SimplePDF (Terms, Privacy), StackBlitz (Terms, Privacy), Val Town (Terms, Privacy), GIPHY (Terms, Privacy) and Reddit (Terms, Privacy).

Open-source Libraries

The plugin was made possible by the following open-source libraries (thank you!):

  • neo-draw--excalidraw-thirdparty: Source: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw – License: MIT – https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/LICENSE
  • neo-freemius--thirdparty: Source: https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk – License: GPLv3 – https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk/blob/master/LICENSE.txt
  • _global-lucide-icons-thirdparty: Source: https://lucide.dev/icons/ – License: ISC License – https://lucide.dev/license

sections.faq:
Features of neo Draw

Which features are included in the plugin?

The main features of the Whiteboard plugin are:

  • ✅ Unleash your creativity 🎉
  • ✅ Create diagrams with shapes, icons and pen drawings
  • ✅ Unlimited drawings
  • ✅ Paint on existing images
  • ✅ SVG export and import on other sites
  • ✅ Image editing with Apple Pencil
  • ✅ Insert CSV content as a diagram
  • ✅ Interactive image areas with hyperlinks
  • ✅ More professional fonts
  • ✅ Export as SVG or PNG
  • ✅ Integration with Bricks, Elementor, Gutenberg and the Classic Editor
  • ✅ Extensive icon library

neoDraw optimize SVGs

How does neoOptimize optimize drawings from neoDraw?

When a graphic was created with neoDraw, neoOptimize can automatically optimize it when serving it on the frontend. Unnecessary editor data is removed for display and embedded raster images are converted to the efficient AVIF format.

The original neoDraw file remains fully intact and editable. Visitors receive a leaner, faster version on the frontend while you can still work with the editable original drawing in the backend.

neoDraw – transfer drawings

How can I transfer drawings created with neoDraw to another website?

Drawings created with neoDraw can be downloaded like regular images as SVG or PNG files and uploaded to another WordPress instance. For SVG upload to work, it must either be enabled manually or the neoLibrary must be used for the upload. The drawings can still be edited with neoDraw after the upload because the drawing data is embedded in both the SVG and PNG formats.

neoDraw – export drawing

Can I export neoDraw drawings as a PNG file?

Yes, drawings created with neoDraw can be downloaded as PNG files via the neoLibrary. All drawing data is embedded as metadata directly into the PNG file. Even with the raster format, the full restoration of the original SVG is possible – including all editable drawing elements. If such a PNG file is later reuploaded with neoLibrary, it is automatically converted back into an SVG file that can be edited with neoDraw.

neoDraw – file format

In which format are neoDraw drawings stored?

Drawings created with neoDraw are stored in the WordPress media library as vector graphics in SVG format – just like regular images. On the file system these SVG files sit alongside the other images in the WordPress media library. Therefore all drawings created with neoDraw can still be used even after uninstalling the plugin.

All editor drawing data, including embedded images and animations from neoAnimate & neoMotion, is stored directly in the SVG file. This ensures the drawing remains fully editable even after downloading and reuploading – for example on another WordPress instance. On the frontend the SVG files are treated like ordinary images.

For maximum performance the neoOptimize plugin automatically removes the editor data when serving the SVG files and converts embedded raster images to the efficient WebP format.

neoDraw – drawings without Pro

What happens to my drawings and animations without Pro?

If you no longer use a Pro license, your existing drawings and animations remain fully intact and continue to work on the frontend.

The Pro features inside the drawings (e.g. advanced animation settings) cannot be edited without a license. Displaying and exporting is still possible because your drawings are stored as regular SVG files.

If you switch back to neoPro later, all Pro features become available again without restrictions.

neoDraw – and the neoUniverse

How does neoDraw work with the other plugins?

The neoDraw plugin unfolds its full power in combination with the other plugins of the neoUniverse – especially in practical use cases. For example: You run a web design agency and want to integrate a visual route description on a client’s website. With neoDraw you create a sketch showing the route to the location directly on a map excerpt. Then you use neoAnimate to display the route as an animated path so visitors immediately see how to get there. To ensure the graphic is optimally indexed by search engines you name it SEO-friendly with neoRename and add the location to the filename. The neoOptimize plugin automatically handles compression and adapts the image size to different devices. At the same time neoLazy ensures the image only loads when it is actually needed – saving load time and improving the user experience. If the client’s location changes you can quickly and losslessly replace the graphic with neoReplace – all links remain intact. With neoLibrary you always keep an overview of your media files and see exactly which images are used in which posts – ideal for cleaning up and organizing.

Neo-Universe

What is the neoUniverse?

The neoUniverse is more than just a plugin collection. It is your complete toolbox for all media challenges in WordPress. It currently includes ten specialized plugins: neoLibrary, neoRename, neoReplace, neoDuplicate, neoOptimize, neoLazy, neoDraw, neoAnimate and neoMotion. They work seamlessly together, are perfectly coordinated and cover all areas around media management, SEO and performance. Whether renaming images, replacing files, optimizing for SEO, enabling lazy load or drawing and animating content. The neoUniverse makes your media workflow noticeably simpler and more efficient. And the best part: The neoUniverse keeps expanding. New tools and features make your WordPress daily routine even better.

Download with Safari

Why does only a folder appear when downloading?

If you use Safari, your Mac may automatically unzip the ZIP file. Instead of the ZIP file you then only get the unzipped folder. You cannot upload this directly to WordPress.

Solution: Open Safari preferences and disable the option ”Open safe files after downloading”. After that the ZIP file will remain as you need it.

The video titled ”How to disable Safari auto extract for ZIP files when downloading WordPress plugins” on YouTube shows exact details.

More questions

I have more questions. Can you help me?

Sure! You can always submit your questions to us via our Support page. We will reply shortly.
